title: Fish's Create plus
description: 🔧 A Create-based modpack with addons, worldgen, performance boosts & immersive features.
body:
🎣 **Fish's Create Plus** is a modpack designed to offer a Minecraft 1.20.1 experience focused on technical creativity, immersive exploration, and optimized performance. 🔧 **Create at its core**: centered on a robust mechanical toolkit and a wide selection of compatible addons, it lets you build factories, mechanical systems, trains, and stylish structures with precision and flair. 📌 Note: The Factory Must Grow is currently included in an older version because the latest update lost some of its charm. If the community requests it, it will be updated. 🌍 **Exploration & atmosphere**: enhanced world generation and seasonal systems turn the world into a vibrant, living ecosystem. Navigation and exploration tools help you find and understand landmarks and biomes. 🎧 **Visual & audio immersion**: graphical and sound enhancements elevate the sensory experience and make exploration and base-building feel richer and more atmospheric. ⚙️ **Optimized performance**: multiple performance improvements and optimizers help the pack run smoothly even on lower-end systems. 🧭 **Quality of life**: interface, mapping, and utility improvements streamline building, debugging, and inventory management to keep gameplay intuitive and enjoyable. 🍲 **Extra content**: additional culinary and interactive systems add flavorful layers that complement the technical core without overpowering it. ✨ **Fish's Create Plus** is ideal for players who want a stylish, technical, and stable Minecraft experience that rewards creativity and exploration.
